title: CBDT Notifies Rules and Forms for Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers Disclosure Scheme, 2026
content:
# CBDT Notifies Rules and Forms for Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers Disclosure Scheme, 2026

Ek important update hai! The Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) ne "Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers Disclosure Scheme, 2026" ke liye rules aur forms notify kar diye hain. Ye small taxpayers ke liye ek significant relief hai.

Here's a quick rundown:

*   **Notification Details:** CBDT ne Notification No. 114/2026 (F. No. 370142/18/2026-TPL) notify kiya hai. Although the notification was officially issued on August 14, 2026, the Income Tax Department ne iska update September 01, 2026, ko publish kiya hai.
*   **Scheme Overview:** This scheme is a one-time voluntary disclosure window, introduced through the Finance Act, 2026. Iska aim un eligible taxpayers ko ek mauka dena hai jinhone specific undisclosed foreign assets ya foreign income ko pehle report nahi kiya tha.
*   **Effective Dates:** The scheme became effective from August 16, 2026, aur declaration file karne ki last date December 31, 2026, hai. Iske baad koi declaration accept nahi kiya jayega.
*   **Valuation Date:** Foreign assets ki Fair Market Value (FMV) determine karne ke liye valuation date March 31, 2026, set ki gayi hai.
*   **Disclosure Categories:**
    *   **Category 1:** Undisclosed foreign assets ya income, jahan aggregate FMV ₹1 Crore tak hai. Is par 30% tax plus 100% of such tax (effective 60%) payable hoga.
    *   **Category 2:** Foreign assets jo income se acquire kiye gaye the while the taxpayer was a Non-Resident (NR) ya jinka income already tax ho chuka tha, but not reported. Yahan aggregate FMV ₹5 Crore tak hai, aur is par ₹1 Lakh ki fixed fee pay karni hogi.
*   **Forms:** Scheme electronically operate karegi. Declaration ke liye Form 1, amount payable ke liye Form 2, payment proof ke liye Form 3, aur certification ke liye Form 4 prescribe kiye gaye hain.
*   **Immunity:** Valid declaration aur payment karne par, taxpayers ko Black Money (Undisclosed Foreign Income and Assets) and Imposition of Tax Act, 2015 ke तहत further tax, penalty aur prosecution se immunity milegi.

## Read the Official Document
*   [Download the Official Notification/Circular here](https://www.incometax.gov.in/iec/foportal/latest-updates) (Please navigate to the "01 Sep 2026" entry titled "CBDT has issued Notification No. 114/2026..." and click on the "Click here" link for the document.)

*Published on: 1 September 2026*
